name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index of Treasury volatility at 101 on 16 Nov, back above the 100 Watch line; US 10-year yield 5.12%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 101 on 16 Nov, 18% higher on the week and above the 100 Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 5.12%, little changed over the month and well inside the 40bp monthly move line. Weak 10- and 30-year auctions on 10 and 12 Nov had already put Treasury demand in focus.
for_you: Higher and more volatile US yields tend to feed through to global borrowing costs, including fixed mortgage rates, over weeks.
why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
